questions.explanation: HCL is the HashiCorp Configuration Language.

questions.prompt: Which block type defines an input parameter for a Terraform configuration?
questions.explanation: The variable block defines an input parameter.

questions.prompt: How do you reference a variable named model_name in HCL?
Which file conventionally stores provider version constraints?
questions.explanation: Provider version constraints are conventionally placed in versions.tf.

questions.prompt: Which block exposes a value after terraform apply?
questions.explanation: The output block exposes values after apply.
